correctness.rationale: The ten first-level maps follow exactly from the normal subgroups of S_3, giving six automorphisms, three image-C2 sign maps, and the zero map. Their explicit composition law has six units and five idempotents. Every second-level semigroup homomorphism sends the identity to one of these five idempotents. For identity image, its restriction to six units is a group endomorphism (10 possibilities), and four remaining images must be among five idempotents, so a complete test of 6250 candidates yields 33 maps with verified ranks. For identity image equal to one of three nonzero singular idempotents, the target local monoid has two elements and there are exactly three maps per choice; image zero yields one constant map. Full total 43 and polynomial follow. Checker reconstructs and exhausts all relevant maps; no incomplete extrapolation.

value.rationale: The paper initiating the finite symmetric-group endomorphism tower explicitly omits exceptional degrees below seven; the first nonabelian degree is a canonical natural boundary. Its full second-level monoid and image-rank polynomial are exact structural invariants, and the nonunital distinction changes the count from 33 to 43, with four impossible intermediate ranks. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary slice, while making no claim for all degrees.
